user.title: Add an air conditioner
user.description: Set up one AC indoor unit connected through an AB64 box and a Modbus TCP↔RTU gateway (e.g. an Elfin EW11). Name it after the AC unit or the room it's in, not the gateway (see below) — host and port are the gateway's own TCP connection, while unit-id below is the AB64 box's own address on that gateway.

data_description.name: Sets this AC's entity IDs when they are first created — name it after the AC unit or room, not the gateway.
data_description.port: The TCP port your gateway listens on for Modbus — 502 is the Modbus standard, but check your gateway's own configuration page (an Elfin EW11 defaults to 8899).
data_description.unit_id: The AB64 box's own address on the gateway — unit-id = SW2 × 16 + SW1 + 1 (the vendor's switch table is 1-based, so switches at 0,0 mean 1, not 0). Leave blank to scan 1-64 instead, which takes up to about a minute.

select_unit.title: Confirm the AB64 unit-id
select_unit.description: One or more unit-ids responded on this gateway. If you're not sure which one is this AC, turn it on/off (or change its mode) with the remote and see which entry's state changes to match — the values shown are read live, not cached.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AB64 connection
reconfigure.description: Change the gateway's host/TCP port or the AB64 box's own unit-id for this AC unit. The new values are re-verified by reading register 0 before saving.

data_description.port: The TCP port your gateway listens on for Modbus — 502 is the Modbus standard, but check your gateway's own configuration page (an Elfin EW11 defaults to 8899).

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to the gateway. Check host, port, and that the gateway is reachable on the network.
error.read_timeout: Connected to the gateway, but the AB64 did not respond on this unit-id. Check wiring, baud rate, and DIP switch address.
error.no_units_found: No unit-id in the 1-64 range responded. Check wiring, baud rate, and that the gateway is bridged to the RS-485 bus.
error.all_units_already_configured: Every unit-id that responded on this gateway is already set up as another entry. Nothing new to add here.
error.already_configured: This host, port, and unit-id combination is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This host, port, and unit-id combination is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: One read takes about 115 ms (measured on real hardware), and this integration reads 2 register blocks per poll by default — 3 with advanced telemetry enabled. So one AC alone at a 1-second interval uses roughly 23% of the RS-485 bus's time, or about 35% with advanced telemetry on. Four AB64 units sharing one gateway at 1 second each would saturate it. Pick a value based on how many AB64 units share this gateway, not just this one entry.
data_description.enable_advanced_telemetry: Turns on roughly 12 additional sensors for indoor/outdoor telemetry (temperatures, compressor current/speed, fan speeds). Some of these registers aren't present on every AC model or firmware — those sensors will go unavailable on their own. But if one instead shows a value stuck at 0 that never moves even under heavy load, suspect that register isn't supported on this AC rather than trusting it as a real reading.

error.scan_interval_too_low: Poll interval must be at least 1 second — this bus may be shared with other AB64 units on the same gateway.
